key_insight: PneuGen uses collaborating LLM agents and simulation feedback to efficiently co-design soft pneumatic robots for specific tasks.
engineering_relevance: The framework helps navigate coupled geometry, material, morphology, and actuation choices for task-specific soft robot design.
method: A designer agent proposes design programs using a parametric component library.
Validated programs become finite-element simulations, supported by fitted geometry–pressure–deformation response models.
A critic agent interprets simulation diagnostics and recommends targeted design revisions.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports significant gains over computational optimisation baselines on grasping and planar/3D shape-matching tasks, supporting ablations, and real-world demonstrations.
watch_item: Performance may depend on component-library coverage and the accuracy of fitted response models and finite-element simulations.
paper_title: PneuGen: Task-Driven Agentic Co-Design of Soft Pneumatic Robots
